title: Verdacht des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels mit Waffen – vier Festnahmen

extraction.summaryEn: Police observed a drug handover in Jessnerstraße on Friday evening and then searched several vehicles and homes, seizing about 2.7 kg of cocaine, around 900 g of ecstasy and other drugs, plus a firearm and 6,000 euros in cash. Four suspects were detained for identification and then released.
